content: Small-business clients want: case studies written from the client's point of view (problem, what was done, business outcome), relevance to their industry/size, plain language over developer jargon, visible real sites, and a low-friction contact path. Recruiters/hiring managers want: role clarity, decisions and trade-offs, code and live links, tests, README. Same case study can serve both if it opens with business framing and keeps technical decisions in a labelled section.
